recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5347 unless the work group later changes the Timing repeat model or MedicationRequest dosage representation.
issue_request: FHIR-5347 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Jan 2015 ballot comment for MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction.scheduled[x] asking how to express common frequency ranges such as Every 4-6 hours. Its final resolution says to see the resolution to FHIR-3841.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5347 was found. The linked FHIR-3841 decision was applied by historical git-svn commit db55db7414cc49a9bd93c668c9fd19c3de26fccf, which restructured Timing and added the representative examples that answer this ballot comment.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is no longer an active current-build resource; source/fhir.ini records that it became MedicationRequest. The substantive issue is therefore whether the active Timing datatype can represent the requested schedule ranges. Current source/datatypes/timing.xml defines the needed range fields, and source/datatypes.html includes the exact Every 4-6 hours example and related duration examples. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative Timing source and narrative already satisfy the ballot comment after considering its linked FHIR-3841 resolution and later resource renaming.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-5347's resolution explicitly delegates the Timing datatype fix to FHIR-3841.
